property_summary: For any inputs with a non-empty _tos array, calling transfer(...) always returns (completes) successfully (i.e. does not revert); the mutant instead always reverts, so for some fuzzed inputs the call to transfer will revert while the reference never reverts.
change_summary: Change the return true; to revert with a message, causing the function to always revert at the end instead of returning.
